{{Quote|Good idea. We can get Darric Tevul to report regularly on&mdash;''"<br />"''No, no, not just commentary. I think we should put someone on the scene.|Sima Shadar and Perre Needmo|<ref name="Allies" />}}
'''Darric Tevul''' was a [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] for ''[[The Perre Needmo Newshour]]''<ref name="Allies" /> in [[44 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Sima Shadar]], the show's producer, suggested Tevul to report on the growing discourse regarding [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] on [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Karfeddion/Legends|Karfeddion]] and [[Thalassia/Legends|Thalassia]] but [[Perre Needmo]] shot down the idea and asserted they needed to put a reporter on the scenes instead.<ref name="Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darric Tevul was first mentioned in the [[2010]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'' written by [[Christie Golden]].<ref name="Allies" />
